{{Quote|After cross-checking numerous accounts of your recent exploits with a detailed report provided by Risha Drayen, the Galactic Finders Guild is pleased to formally record your name as the locator of Nok Drayen's lost fortune, aka Missing Wealth Collection #3263827.|Hrenn Indiru's letter to the Voidhound|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hrenn Indiru''' was the Chief Secretary of the [[Galactic Finders Guild]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3643 BBY]]. He sent a formal letter to the [[Voidhound]] in which he congratulated the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] on finding [[Nok Drayen]]'s treasure, or the Missing Wealth Collection #3263827 as the Guild referred to it. He also thanked the Voidhound for defeating Skavak, noting that the notorious gangster had been causing the Guild problems for years.
